description: Tintype portrait of Rebecca Salsbury James (on left) and Georgia O'Keeffe (on right). Both women are wearing large brimmed hats and what appears to be Native American jewelry: strands of beads around their necks and silver cuff bracelets. Tintype in decorative art nouveau-style card frame with the imprint: Souvenir From.
imageCaption: Unknown photographer. Rebecca Salsbury James and Georgia O'Keeffe, 1929. tintypes (prints). Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation Photographs. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation.
title: Rebecca Salsbury James and Georgia O'Keeffe
